{{Top|leg}}
A '''sound slug machine''' was a device used for playing [[Music/Legends|music]]. They contained [[sound slug]]s and [[Holovid/Legends|mini-holovids]] that could be selected by individuals to play, usually after [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] were inserted into a slot. [[Reuther's Wetdock]] on [[Najiba/Legends|Najiba]] had a dilapidated sound slug machine installed. Every year, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Thaddeus Ross]] would play "[[Laughter After Dark]]" performed by [[Saahir Ru'luv]], a drink a bottle of [[t'ssolok]] to her memory.<ref name="LAD">{{JournalCite|15|Laughter After Dark (short story)}}</ref>
